title: Datadog Application key (legacy 40-hex): one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one "g" at offset 20, outside the corroborated [a-f0-9] body; width unchanged. Twin of "Datadog Application key (legacy 40-hex): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
